attr.title: The Escapists
attr.desc: The Escapists is a strategy and simulation game in which you follow the daily routine of a prisoner while planning your escape. Follow the prison schedule, complete jobs, collect items, craft tools, improve your skills, and find a way out without raising suspicion.
attr.inst:
1 - Legally purchase and download the Linux version of The Escapists from GOG.
2 - Place the downloaded GOG installer (.sh) inside: ports/theescapists/gamedata 
3 - Launch The Escapists from the Ports section.
4 - The port will automatically detect and extract the installer.
5 - Wait for the process to finish. The game will start automatically.
